description:
Resolve the remaining user-facing interaction defects:
- `components/SearchBar.js:125-135` / `meridian.js:627-633`: route Enter-launched web search through the public clear path so the query handler and popup cannot retain stale results.
- `components/SettingsPanel.js:217-227` / `meridian.js:149-170`: parse and normalize homepage URLs, allow only supported `http:`/`https:` schemes, show validation feedback, and catch navigation failures.
- `components/sidebar.js:179-209,324-358,456-459`: replace non-focusable result/tab divs with semantic controls or add correct focusability, accessible role/name, and Enter/Space activation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Enter web search leaves an empty field and cleared popup state.
- Invalid, relative, and unsupported-scheme homepage values are rejected; valid URLs are normalized.
- Sidebar rows are reachable and operable by keyboard with visible focus.
- Regression tests cover all three behaviors.
label: Bug
title: Fix web-search clearing, homepage URL validation, and sidebar keyboard access

activity.content:
Implemented all three interaction fixes:

- Web searches submitted with Enter now use `clearSearch()`, clearing both the field and popup/query state.
- Homepage settings now accept only absolute HTTP(S) URLs, normalize valid values, expose inline accessible validation feedback, and guard startup navigation failures.
- Sidebar tab, previous-tab, and search-result rows now have focusability, accessible button names, Enter/Space activation, and visible focus styling.
- Kept the root and packaged extension sources synchronized.

Validation: `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` - 40 tests passed; affected JavaScript files also passed `node --check`, and `git diff --check` passed.
Reviewer approved: implementation/output verified against the task scope; combined suite passes (41/41) and shipped source/package parity passes.
